description: PCB, gerber for PCB fabrication, just upload this zip file to jlcpcb.com and order your PCB.
Wemos D1 MINI V4.0 (any other version of WeMos that shares the output pins should work)
Mini Micro Limit Switch Roller Lever Arm (MS-1A-14.5-P)
A4988 stepper motor driver+heat sink (It is quite easy to burn it, especially if you are a beginner, better 2 units)
2K ohms resistors for R1 if firmware version >=1.4
Wire 2P 30AWG (for limit switch filament sensor, digital signal, I use the very thin wires stripped from an old LPT1 printer cable)
Wire 2P 18AWG (I use 25cm from the hotend heater cable)
10A 250V Male Power Socket 3 Pin IEC320 switch + Fuse
Terminal Wire Conector Crimp Insulated Ferrule 20AWG (PCB power, IEC320, heater) 24AWG (micro switch)
